human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Ailuros already rejects malformed packages and preserves missing governance facts as unknown, but production evidence still leaves terminal lifecycle/outcome and authority/approval/budget largely unprovable. Add a small producer-neutral capability-conformance layer that answers a narrower question before governance evaluation: which governance capabilities are actually evaluable from this package, which are unsupported by the producer, and which are missing required evidence. This must extend the existing canonical evidence package boundary rather than create an EverRun adapter or a new framework abstraction.
human_pressure.why_now: Post-8082 evidence shows the bottleneck is no longer consumer semantics but producer evidence sufficiency. More verification-only packs cannot turn unknown into evidence-backed decisions.
do_not_misread: Conformance is not a governance decision and must not promote unknown to clean/pass.
A producer may be partially conformant; unsupported capabilities are not package corruption.
EverRun is only the first production reference producer, not the schema owner.
This pack does not require authority, approval or budget evidence to exist when the producer does not perform those decisions.
red_lines: No synthesized authority, approval, budget, outcome or terminal facts.
Do not weaken the existing manifest/timeline structural validator.
Do not expand the frozen governance semantic surface merely to improve coverage.

machine_core.goal: Expose deterministic capability-level evidence conformance for canonical packages so producers can see exactly which Ailuros governance capabilities are evaluable before import/rebuild.
red_lines: Keep structural package validity separate from capability evidence sufficiency.
Missing optional governance evidence must yield unavailable/unsupported/partial semantics, never fabricated success.
Capability rules must depend only on canonical event types and structured payload fields, not producer labels or free-form text.
invariants: Package validity and governance capability availability are separate dimensions.
The same canonical event set yields the same capability-conformance result regardless of manifest source label.
Unsupported is distinct from missing required evidence and from malformed evidence.
Existing governance projections remain authoritative for actual governance judgments.

observable_effect.assertion: A structurally valid package produces a deterministic capability matrix for lifecycle, outcome, regression prerequisites, authority, approval, budget, scope and validation without producer-specific branches.

proofs.assertion: A package with authoritative terminal evidence marks lifecycle evaluable; removing only that terminal evidence changes lifecycle to missing evidence without changing structural package validity.
Relabeling producer metadata leaves the capability matrix unchanged.
Absent authority/approval/budget evidence never becomes satisfied or clean.

failure_semantics: Malformed canonical package remains a structural validation failure.
Valid package with insufficient evidence remains valid but reports capability-specific missing evidence.
Explicitly unsupported capability is reported as unsupported, not failed and not evaluated.
Contradictory canonical evidence remains available to downstream consistency/governance logic and must not be hidden by conformance reporting.

steps.title: Define the minimum capability matrix
details: Document the minimum canonical evidence required to evaluate lifecycle, outcome, regression prerequisites, authority, approval, budget, scope and validation.
Use a closed status vocabulary such as evaluable, missing_evidence, unsupported; add malformed only if it represents already-validated structured evidence and does not duplicate package validation.
Do not require every producer to implement every capability.

steps.title: Implement deterministic conformance evaluation
details: Keep source/agent/framework metadata out of decision logic.
Return precise missing evidence identifiers rather than prose-only reasons.

steps.title: Expose conformance through the existing CLI surface
details: Prefer extending evidence-audit output or adding one small evidence-conformance command, whichever is simpler in the current CLI architecture.
Human output must identify capability, status and missing evidence; machine-readable output must be deterministic.
Do not make partial conformance a non-zero process exit when the package itself is structurally valid unless current CLI conventions already require it.

steps.title: Lock source neutrality and no-fabrication behavior
details: Relabel source metadata to an arbitrary unseen producer and prove identical results.
Remove terminal, authority, approval or budget evidence independently and prove only the corresponding capabilities degrade.
Do not add synthetic fixtures pretending to be production evidence; compact unit fixtures are allowed only to test evaluator mechanics.

acceptance: A structurally valid canonical package yields a deterministic capability matrix.
Lifecycle terminal evidence sufficiency is distinguishable from structural validity.
Authority/approval/budget absence is explicit and never promoted.
Producer label relabeling is behaviorally inert.
Full test suite, ruff and mypy pass.

must_check: Capability conformance is separate from package structural validity and governance judgment.
Rules use canonical structured evidence only and do not branch on producer identity.
Missing or unsupported authority/approval/budget evidence is never fabricated into evaluated success.
The implementation reuses the existing evidence package boundary and introduces at most one small abstraction.
CLI output is deterministic and actionable for producers.
No frozen projection/regression semantics were changed.
reject_if: Any EverRun-specific parser or source == everrun semantic branch is introduced.
Partial conformance is treated as package corruption merely because optional capabilities are unsupported.
Missing evidence is inferred from free-form text or converted to clean/pass/success.
The pack expands the governance ontology or regression ordering without new production evidence.
Forbidden files are modified or validation fails.
